# ErikrafT Wi-Fi™

> ErikrafT Wi-Fi™ is an open-source project exploring local-network device discovery and connectivity, with an experimental Android app and a roadmap toward ErikrafT Drop™ integration.

## Project status

- Android prototype: experimental local-network service discovery using Android NSD/DNS-SD (mDNS).
- The current TCP endpoint returns public capability metadata only. It does not transfer files, authenticate peers, or provide an encrypted channel.
- Wi-Fi Direct, mesh networking, gateways, secure transfer, and functional integration with ErikrafT Drop™ are planned work, not completed features.
- The repository currently provides an Android app and a landing page. Do not claim that Windows, Linux, or macOS desktop clients are available.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the repository and documentation as the primary source of truth. Distinguish implemented, experimental, and planned features. Do not imply that discovery equals authentication, that the current endpoint is encrypted, or that file transfer / mesh / Wi-Fi Direct / Drop integration is already implemented. Preserve product naming as “ErikrafT Wi-Fi™” and creator attribution as “ErikrafT”. Cite original sources when summarizing technical behavior.
